newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank raises $400 mln for nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: China bank raises $400 mln for nuclear plant.

text.p: China's State Development Bank had extended $100 million worth of credit to the Ling'ao nuclear power plant in southern Guangdong and raised $400 million in international commercial loans by end-April, the bank said.

Bank president Yao Zhenyan, attending the ground-breaking for the plant this week, said his bank had signed $2.3 billion worth of export credits and loans agreements for the project and would be responsible for raising $1.8 billion in international commercial loans for construction, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
Other participants in the fund-raising include France's Banque Nationale de Paris. French company Framatome is providing the reactors for the plant.
The Ling'ao plant, near the Daya Bay nuclear plant on the border with Hong Kong, will cost an estimated $4 billion.
The plant will have four 1,000 megawatt generators, with the first two due to begin commercial operation in July 2002 and March 2003, Xinhua said.
